translations.note: A cross-reference in the sidenote that goes with Plutarch's opinion in the main text: Chrysostom says nearly the same thing in volume 2, his commentary on chapter 6 of Romans, sermon 11. Here 'Idem' means 'the same thing', not 'the same author'.
